run_glue_sst2_main: run the main function to generate 16-shot SST2 data for multiple random seeds
create_glue_sst2_dataset: create a Glue_SST2 instance to load and preprocess the GLUE SST2 sentiment dataset
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of sentence and label tuples
load_glue_sst2_dataset: load the GLUE SST2 dataset from HuggingFace using the load_dataset method
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot train dev and test splits for few-shot learning with a given seed
